_comment: Servable models, for the demo panel and for anything else that needs to name a model
rather than a file path. Test metrics are the measured holdout figures and must not be
edited to match expectations; a model with no measured number carries null, not a guess.
`temperature` is the value fitted on that model's own validation split by
cropguard.evaluation.calibrate — sharing a temperature between models is not valid.

models.name: ResNet50 baseline
models.note: The deployed model. Serves traffic on Render.

models.name: ConvNeXt-Tiny challenger
models.note: Higher macro-F1, marginally lower accuracy. The promotion gate declined it.

models.name: ResNet50 static INT8
models.temperature_note: Inherited from the fp32 parent, not refitted. Valid only because quantisation is accuracy-neutral here (9 disagreements in 3,000); a genuinely different model must have its own T.
models.note: Accuracy-neutral against fp32 on a 3,000-image subset (0.9897 vs 0.9893, 9 disagreements), but not evaluated on the full holdout, so no headline figure is claimed. 4x smaller and 3.2x slower than fp32 on a CPU without VNNI instructions - compare the two here to find out which way it goes on this hardware.
